user.title: Connect your sonnenBatterie
user.description: Turn on the JSON API in the battery's dashboard (Software-Integration) and copy the API token. Enable write access too if you want to change the operating mode or backup reserve from Home Assistant.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the battery, e.g. 192.168.1.50
data_description.api_token: The token shown under Software-Integration in the battery's dashboard
data_description.model: Determines the housing colour shown in the dashboard. The battery does not report its model.
data_description.protect: Backup power: Performance with Protect 8000, Performance+ (built in), sonnenBatterie 10 with Protect 4000. Only then the dashboard offers the backup reserve.
data_description.dashboard: Which view appears in the sidebar. Classic = portal in the style of my.sonnen, Modern = house view with energy flow. Can be changed later under Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The battery at {host} rejected the API token. Enter the current token from its dashboard.

data_description.api_token: The token shown under Software-Integration in the battery's dashboard

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the battery, e.g. 192.168.1.50
data_description.api_token: The token shown under Software-Integration in the battery's dashboard

replace_unit.title: Replaced power unit?
replace_unit.description: The battery now reports serial number {new} instead of {old}. That happens when the power unit was replaced. Take over the new serial number? Entities, entity IDs and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the battery. Check the host and that the JSON API is turned on.
error.invalid_auth: The battery rejected the API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.
error.protect_mismatch: This Protect does not fit the model. Protect 8000 goes with the Performance, Protect 4000 with the sonnenBatterie 10. The Performance+ has backup built in, hybrid has none.

abort.already_configured: This battery is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That's a different battery from the one this entry is for.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between readings. Shorter intervals make the energy counters more accurate.
data_description.model: Determines the housing colour shown in the dashboard.
data_description.protect: Backup power: Performance with Protect 8000, Performance+ (built in), sonnenBatterie 10 with Protect 4000. Only then the dashboard offers the backup reserve.
data_description.dashboard: Which view appears in the sidebar. Classic = portal in the style of my.sonnen, Modern = house view with energy flow.
data_description.wallbox_id: OCPP id of the sonnenCharger 3, usually its serial number (e.g. ACE0871215). Empty = no wallbox. In the Alfen ACE Service Installer set the CSMS URL to ws://<Home Assistant IP>:8123/api/zeo_sonnen/ocpp/ and restart the wallbox.
data_description.wallbox_max_current: Highest current per phase the wallbox may use, as the supply line allows (e.g. 16 A at B16).

error.protect_mismatch: This Protect does not fit the model. Protect 8000 goes with the Performance, Protect 4000 with the sonnenBatterie 10. The Performance+ has backup built in, hybrid has none.
error.invalid_wallbox_id: Only letters, digits and . _ : - are allowed (at most 48 characters).

wallbox_invalid_current.message: The current must be 0 (pause) or at least 6 A.

wallbox_command_failed.message: The wallbox {charge_point} did not carry out the command: {error}

write_failed.message: The battery didn't accept the change. Check that write access is enabled for the API token.

setpoint_failed.message: The battery didn't accept the power setpoint. It must be in manual operating mode, and write access must be enabled for the API token.

entry_not_loaded.message: That sonnenBatterie isn't loaded right now.

auth_failed.message: The battery rejected the API token.

update_failed.message: Couldn't read data from the battery: {error}

options.modern: sonnenBatterie Modern (house view with energy flow)
options.classic: sonnenBatterie Classic (portal in the style of my.sonnen)

wallbox_set_limit.name: Limit wallbox current
wallbox_set_limit.description: Sets the charging current and number of phases of the wallbox. 0 A pauses charging without ending the session. Single phase is capped at 16 A.

charge_point_id.name: Wallbox
charge_point_id.description: OCPP id of the wallbox, e.g. the serial number ACE0871215.

current.name: Current
current.description: Current per phase in ampere: 0 (pause) or 6 to 32.

phases.name: Phases
phases.description: Charge on 3 phases or on 1 phase.

valid_for.name: Valid for
valid_for.description: Minutes after which the wallbox drops the limit by itself and charges at full power again (fail-safe). Empty = until changed.

wallbox_clear_limit.name: Remove wallbox limit
wallbox_clear_limit.description: Removes the limit; the wallbox charges with its own maximum current again.

charge_point_id.name: Wallbox
charge_point_id.description: OCPP id of the wallbox, e.g. the serial number ACE0871215.

wallbox_get_configuration.name: Read wallbox configuration
wallbox_get_configuration.description: Reads OCPP configuration keys from the wallbox.

charge_point_id.name: Wallbox
charge_point_id.description: OCPP id of the wallbox, e.g. the serial number ACE0871215.

set_power.name: Set battery power
set_power.description: Charges or discharges the battery at a fixed power. Only works in manual operating mode. Set 0 W to stop.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Charge into the battery, or discharge out of it.

power.name: Power
power.description: Power in watts. The battery limits this to what its inverter can do.
